title: Static review replay recovery
description: Isolated production gateway and real browser controls prove replay refusal without run mutation and a usable same-PR recovery path. A real task workspace and tmux session prove the unacknowledged-start deadline and accepted task progress. No paid reviewer is launched by this recipe.

replay-and-request.intent: Review recovery refuses unsafe replay and retains the selected attempt.

startup-deadline.intent: Startup expiry blocks unaccepted work while preserving later genuine progress.
